InputRouteDiscovery.description: One evidence-grounded route without imposing a taxonomy label.

route_label.description: Concise document-grounded label for exactly one source-to-model path. Do not create an additional combined or fused route merely because a configuration uses several already-recorded routes together.
route_label.title: Route Label

model_name.description: Named generative model receiving the input. Copy the paper's name.
model_name.title: Model Name

lifecycle_phase_verbatim.description: One lifecycle phase stated by the paper, such as pretraining, instruction tuning, inference, or evaluation. Create separate route records when the same source-to-model path must be represented in different phases. Do not normalize the paper's phase wording yet.
lifecycle_phase_verbatim.title: Lifecycle Phase Verbatim

task_or_configuration_verbatim.description: Task or permitted input configuration in which this route is used. Record the paper's wording.
task_or_configuration_verbatim.title: Task Or Configuration Verbatim

source_object_verbatim.description: One biological or textual source object before model preprocessing, copied or closely paraphrased from the paper. Do not combine independent modalities into one source object; each receives its own route.
source_object_verbatim.title: Source Object Verbatim

transformation_chain_verbatim.description: Ordered operations that transform the source object before it reaches the generative model. Preserve the paper's terminology and do not collapse multiple operations into a taxonomy category.
transformation_chain_verbatim.title: Transformation Chain Verbatim

model_visible_form_verbatim.description: What the generative model actually receives: symbols, token IDs, vectors, projected embeddings, feature sequences, or another form.
model_visible_form_verbatim.title: Model Visible Form Verbatim

insertion_or_fusion_verbatim.description: How the represented input is connected to the generative component, using the paper's architectural terminology.
insertion_or_fusion_verbatim.title: Insertion Or Fusion Verbatim

text_role_verbatim.description: Role of text in this phase/configuration. Distinguish an actual input from supervision, a target, or generated output.
text_role_verbatim.title: Text Role Verbatim

input_status_verbatim.description: Whether this is an actual model input, paired training supervision, training-only target, generated output, baseline, ablation, or unclear.
input_status_verbatim.title: Input Status Verbatim

evidence_quote.description: One short contiguous verbatim quote that directly supports the route. Never join separate passages, invent, or summarize this field.
evidence_quote.title: Evidence Quote

section_heading.description: Heading containing the evidence quote, if visible.
section_heading.title: Section Heading

supporting_figure_or_table.description: Figure/table identifier only when it supports this route. A generated picture description alone is not conclusive evidence.
supporting_figure_or_table.title: Supporting Figure Or Table

uncertainty.description: Concise unresolved ambiguity; null when the route is explicit.
uncertainty.title: Uncertainty

InputRouteDiscovery.title: InputRouteDiscovery

description: Open extraction of all candidate input routes in one paper.

title.description: Paper title copied from the document.
title.title: Title

input_routes.description: All distinct input routes used by the paper's generative model(s). Create separate routes when model, lifecycle phase, task/configuration, source object, model-visible form, or fusion mechanism differs. Include training-only/output/baseline candidates only when needed to explicitly distinguish them from usable model inputs. A route begins at exactly one source object. In a multimodal configuration, attach the shared configuration name to every participating route; never emit another combined/fused route that duplicates those participants. A fused latent representation is an intermediate state of its incoming routes, not a new source route.
input_routes.title: Input Routes
